topic: The Transformational View of Derivatives: From Slopes to Sensitivities
target_audience: Undergraduate students in Calculus I or Physics

sections.title: Introduction: The Frozen Snapshot vs. The Flow
lecture_lines: Derivatives move beyond static slopes to dynamic growth.
[Asset: Cheetah_Path] represents the evolving function over time.
[Asset: Derivative_Operator] acts like a speedometer for change.
[Asset: Velocity_Vector] captures the instantaneous growth rate.
This reveals the function's DNA of motion.
animations: Fade in a static curve representing the cheetah's path f(x) in #FFFFFF.
Flash the point of interest in #FF0000 to represent the current location.
Show a tangent line appearing at the point in #FFFF00.
Animate a vector moving along the tangent line in #00FF00 showing the instantaneous velocity.
Fade out the tangent and replace with a labeled 'Speedometer' icon #00FFFF measuring the velocity vector.

sections.title: The Linear Transformation Prism
lecture_lines: Derivatives linearize complex curves at local points.
[Asset: Zoom_In_Curve] reveals a straight line locally.
[Asset: Scale_Factor] dictates how inputs transform outputs.
[Asset: Roller_Coaster_Track] shows the slope's immediate direction.
Small changes in input predict output shifts.
animations: Plot a smooth curve f(x) in #FFFFFF.
Zoom into a small region of the curve until it appears linear in #AAAAAA.
Draw the dx and dy segments forming a right triangle in #FF0000 and #00FF00.
Display the label 'Local Linear Approximation' in #FFFF00.
Animate the triangle shrinking and moving along the curve to demonstrate the linearizing effect.

sections.title: Mapping Change: The Derivative as a Function-to-Function Operator
lecture_lines: Derivatives map functions to new output functions.
[Asset: Position_Function] transforms via the derivative operator.
[Asset: Velocity_Function] emerges as the new mapped result.
animations: Display a function f(x) box in #FFFFFF.
Animate an arrow pointing into a 'Derivative Operator' box in #FF0000.
Emerge a new function f'(x) box from the operator in #00FF00.

sections.title: Synthesis & Visual Summary
lecture_lines: The derivative unifies graphical slopes and transformations.
[Asset: Growth_Tree] visualizes the function's steady progress.
[Asset: Growth_Rhythm] plots the derivative's speed over time.
animations: Display the 'Function' graph on the left and 'Derivative' graph on the right in #FFFFFF.
Synchronize the cursor movement on both graphs to show the 'rhythm' relationship.
Flash the labels 'Position' and 'Rate of Change' in #FFFF00 to unify the concepts.
